kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَلْجُوقِيّ • (saljūqiyy) (feminine سَلْجُوقِيَّة (saljūqiyya), masculine plural سَلْجُوقِيُّون (saljūqiyyūn), feminine plural سَلْجُوقِيَّات (saljūqiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic سَلْجُوق (saljūq)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic سلجوقي
From سَلْجُوق (saljūq, “Saljuq”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: Seljuk (of or related to Seljuk, his dynasty, their empire, or their period of rule)
